item.title: Fully Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing Enabled by Kalman Filtering
item.description: arXiv:2608.03667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Signal fading creates points along the fiber where phase cannot be extracted, so they are conventionally discarded. Instead, we propose a Kalman-based solution for {\phi}-OTDR full-fiber monitoring. Experiments demonstrate phase and temperature estimation with approximately 15 times better spatial density than if removing these points.
